title: Goin' For A Stroll
description:
Horses ahr wonderful animals, truly.  Thay kay-yun be ridden by two people at once, an git this, kay-yun eve-yn be made t' cut duhrt awn their own.  That's right, hit W twice, an ya're hoss will begin movin' forward awn its own, all ya need t' do is steer.  Ya canna course tay-uk control back whenevher ya want.  Oh, eend water? Mud? Pffthah! Don't may-uk me lay-uf.  Such thin's won't stop yo-wr trusty steed.
Wanna know sumthin' eve-yn beder? by hittin' thuh Horse Walk Cycle key (Default: V), ya kay-yun cycule through thuh different speeds: walk, trot, canter, an gallop.  While yo-wr hoss is movin' awn its own, ya kay-yun hold w an s t' gallop at any time, an lettin' gitty-up will jus' 'ave yo-wr hoss continue awn as it was befo-wr.
